title: Readiness Criteria to Move On to Lesson 2 — Memorize A and D Chords and Master Chord Changes
summary: In this brief guidance, JustinGuitar outlines concrete criteria to decide when a beginner is ready to advance from Lesson 1 to Lesson 2. The core requirements are: memorize the A and D chords so you can form and identify them by feel without looking at a chart, and be able to change between those two chords at a steady pace (starting around 30 changes per minute, with a long-term goal of about 60 changes per minute). He emphasizes a practical timeline (most students can reach readiness in 2–4 weeks, with a hard cap of about 4 weeks). If progress stalls or boredom appears after a couple of weeks, it’s acceptable to move on to the next lesson to keep practice engaging, especially if you’ve also managed to play a song and maintain chord-change practice. He also notes that if in doubt, you can watch the final left-handed Lesson 1 video for reassurance before proceeding, and he signs off when readiness is confirmed.
